jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll play a key role in connecting top talent with the right opportunities. You'll manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and interviewing candidates, to advising clients and closing successful placements.

Client Details

You will be joining a small division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row and located in the hearth of Brussels.

Description

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Building and maintaining strong relationships with both clients and candidates

• 
Managing recruitment processes from A to Z

• 
Advising clients on market trends, salary benchmarks and hiring strategies

• 
Actively sourcing talent through various channels and conducting interviews

• 
Collaborating with a high-performing team in a supportive and ambitious environment

We are looking for a (Junior) Recruitment Consultant that :

• 
You speak French and English fluently (Dutch is a strong plus)

• 
You have a strong sense of initiative, and you thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

• 
You enjoy building relationships and helping others succeed

• 
A first experience in sales, recruitment, or a customer-facing role is a plus - but not a must!

• 
You are motivated, resilient, and eager to grow both personally and professionally

Are you passionate about category development, negotiation and commercial performance? As a Category Manager - Wholesale, you will shape the product assortment, identify new market opportunities and build strong supplier relationships. Based in Antwerp, you will play a key role in driving sales, profitability and sustainable growth within the wholesale sector.

 

 

Your responsibilities :

• Develop and optimise the product assortment throughout its lifecycle.
• Drive sales, margins and product turnover through effective category strategies and performance monitoring.
• Identify market trends and translate data into actionable growth opportunities.
• Negotiate competitive agreements, pricing and promotions while building long-term supplier partnerships.
• Collaborate with sales and marketing and coordinate purchase support and replenishment activities.
• Improve purchasing processes and operational efficiency.
 

About you :

• You have a bachelor's or master's degree and experience in purchasing, category management or commercial negotiations.
• You are analytical, commercially minded and confident in negotiations.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and French and have a good command of English.
• You are proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership and working with different stakeholders.
• Experience in FMCG, food, beverages or convenience, along with knowledge of Excel and ERP systems, is an advantage.

Responsibilities

• Manage, maintain, and automate Azure infrastructures following Infrastructure as Code principles.
• Support container platforms based on Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
• Implement and monitor logging, alerting, and performance solutions for cloud environments.
• Maintain cloud network components, security configurations, and access management.
• Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to ensure long-term expertise within the team.
• Analyze existing infrastructure to resolve configuration drift and optimize operational continuity.
• Collaborate with stakeholders in an Agile environment to align security and compliance requirements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience with cloud platforms focusing on Microsoft Azure, AKS, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
• 8+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including state management and modularization.
• 5+ years of experience with containerization technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
• 5+ years of experience with CI/CD automation and version control using GitHub Actions and Git.
• 5+ years of experience with scripting for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
• 3+ years of experience with cloud networking components including Azure Firewall, vWAN, VNets, and DNS.
• 3+ years of experience with monitoring and security tools such as Azure Monitor, Grafana, Key Vault, and RBAC.
• Possess a proactive, result-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrate a collaborative approach within multidisciplined Agile teams.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working knowledge of the other and good professional English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, CKA, or CKAD.
• Experience with GitOps principles and tooling like Flux.
• Experience working in regulated environments or the public sector.
• Familiarity with Jira for project management.
• Willingness to coach and train technical colleagues.

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:

• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:

• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:

• Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.
• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.
• Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.
• Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:

• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of electricity.
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.

Tasks:

• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Who we are looking for: 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.

• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .

• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
